Interface ILoadingService

Namespace
NuvTools.AspNetCore.Blazor.Services
Assembly
NuvTools.AspNetCore.Blazor.dll

Provides a service for managing loading indicator state.

public interface ILoadingService

Remarks

Use this service to coordinate loading overlays across components. Register as scoped in DI and inject where needed. 

@inject ILoadingService LoadingService

<div class="loading-overlay" style="display: @(LoadingService.IsLoading ? "block" : "none")">
    Loading...
</div>

@code {
    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        LoadingService.OnChange += StateHasChanged;
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        LoadingService.OnChange -= StateHasChanged;
    }
}
